BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: B.ARCH   SEMESTER: VIII
BRANCH: ARCHITECTURE   SESSION : SP/2020

SUBJECT : AR8307 DISASTER MANAGEMENT

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Define the term disaster and identify its key elements.  [2]
 (b) Citing suitable examples discuss the socio-political imperatives of disasters. [3]


Q2 (a) Explain the term ‘Risk’ in context to disasters. [2]
 (b) Identify and discuss the indicators of vulnerability in the Indian context. [3]


Q3 (a) Write a short note on the National Disaster Management Policy of India. [2]
 (b) Giving  suitable  examples,  discuss  the  relationship  that  exists  between  disasters  and
development.
[3]


Q4 (a) Explain the terms physical and socio-economic vulnerability in association with disasters. [2]
 (b) Discuss the necessary actions to be considered during the preparedness and rehabilitation
phases of Disaster management. Explain with the help of examples.
[3]


Q5 (a) Giving appropriate examples, discuss direct and indirect impacts of disasters.   [2]
 (b) Identify and briefly highlight the features of the key stages of disaster management cycle
in the case of rapid onset disasters.
[3]


Q6 (a) Discuss the specific role of UNDP and UNDRO during disaster situations.  [2]
 (b) Discuss the specific preparedness measures and post disaster needs for Landslides.  [3]

SUBJECT : AR8307 DISASTER MANAGEMENT

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Define disaster. Discuss why disasters are considered as a fundamental reflection of
normal life.
[2]
 (b) In context to disasters, discuss the terms coping capacity and resilience. Give suitable
examples for the same.
[3]


Q2 (a) Vulnerability, in the context of disaster, is seen as the progression of three stages.
Explain them.
[2]
 (b) Identify and discuss the indicators of vulnerability in the Indian context.  [3]


Q3 (a) Explain  the  terms  physical  and  socio-economic  vulnerability  in  association  with
disasters.
[2]
 (b) Discuss the necessary actions to be considered during the reconstruction and mitigation
phases of Disaster management. Explain with the help of examples.
[3]


Q4 (a) Write a short note on the impacts of disasters. [2]
 (b) Highlight  upon  the  different  relationships  that  exists  between  disasters  and
development. Explain with suitable examples.
[3]


Q5 (a) Write a brief note on United Nations mandate for disaster management.  [2]
 (b) Discuss the specific preparedness measures and post disaster needs for Floods.  [3]


Q6 (a) Write a short note on the Sendai Framework.   [2]
 (b) Highlight upon the role of the National Disaster Management Authority of India.  [3]
